title: fix(cam): make TopologyValidator independent of DXF line endings (DXF-TOPO-CRLF-001)
intent: TopologyValidator parsed the decoded DXF text through io.StringIO without newline translation. ezdxf then read any CRLF (or CR) file as an empty R12 document, so the self-intersection check examined zero entities and reported nothing. The fail-closed export gate (enforce_dxf_validation) therefore blocked a self-intersecting outline stored LF and allowed the identical outline stored CRLF. 73 of the 95 catalog DXFs are stored CRLF. Owner ruling 2026-09-14: fix this first, in its own bounded PR, with an LF/CRLF equivalence regression; no catalog remediation here; rerun the catalog and record newly exposed findings. Owner ruling 2026-09-14 (option 2): also fix the DXF Files gate's import crash in this PR, so the gate runs and reports honestly; turning it green is the separate catalog gate PR.
behavior_change: TopologyValidator now sees the same entities, and returns the same topology report, for LF, CRLF and CR input. Consequence: CRLF DXFs are topology-checked for the first time, so the export gate can now block CRLF uploads that contain self-intersecting or degenerate LWPOLYLINEs, exactly as it already blocked the same geometry stored LF. No rule, threshold or severity changes. DXFPreflight is untouched (it already read via ezdxf.readfile). Second change: the module-level `from app.util.dxf_compat import create_document` moves into the two test-DXF builders that use it. app.util's __init__ imports fastapi, which the DXF Validation Gate job does not install, so the job used to die at import and check nothing. It now runs, and on the current catalog it FAILS 15 of 95 files for real reasons (listed in the investigation note). That red is the gate telling the truth; making it green is the separate DXF catalog gate PR (declarative asset/layer classes plus evidence-backed quarantine records).

diff_articulation.what_changed: One argument: io.StringIO(text_content) becomes io.StringIO(text_content, newline=None) in TopologyValidator.__init__, which turns on universal-newline translation, plus the comment above it. Line count unchanged (620). New regression test file with LF/CRLF/CR witnesses at validator level and through enforce_dxf_validation. New investigation note recording the catalog rerun. Import isolation: the dxf_compat import leaves module level (the import line and its blank separator removed) and is imported inside create_test_figure8_dxf and create_test_valid_dxf. Net line count still 620.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No existing test feeds TopologyValidator CRLF bytes: the smoke tests build DXFs through io.StringIO/doc.encode, which always yields LF, so the defect was invisible to them. The new test fails 12 of 17 cases on the unpatched module (every CRLF and CR case) and passes all 17 with the fix.

catalog acceptance (95 DXFs, ezdxf 1.4.4): entity population vs ezdxf.readfile, LF vs CRLF report equality, patched vs unpatched exposure -> see docs/investigations/dxf_topology_crlf_catalog_rerun_2026-09-14.md
CI-mirror venv (ezdxf 1.4.4, shapely 2.1.2, NO fastapi) from services/api: python -m app.ci.check_dxf_files -> runs; Total 95, Passed 80, Failed 15 (was: ModuleNotFoundError fastapi)
pytest tests/test_topology_validator_line_endings.py tests/test_dxf_advanced_validation_smoke.py tests/test_preflight_gate.py after the import change -> 66 passed

files.behavior_change: CRLF/CR input is now topology-checked; the export gate can block CRLF files it previously passed unchecked; the DXF Validation Gate job now runs instead of crashing at import (and fails on 15 real catalog findings)
